mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.category_name, c.code, c.remark, c.sort, c.status, COALESCE(t.total, 0) AS activity_count FROM activity_category c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM volunteer_activity WHERE deleted = 0 AND category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category_id ) t ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.id ASC
